schema.description: `PUT /v1/app/admin/instances/{id}/domain` — update custom domain (with DNS TXT validation).

cname_target.description:
APP-5 (CNAME challenge): the resolved target of
`{token}.verify.{domain}` as retrieved by the caller's DNS lookup.
Pass together with `cname_token`; wins over `txt_record` when both
are present.

cname_token.description:
APP-5: the challenge token previously generated for this domain
(`sentin8-verify-<32-hex>`).

custom_domain.description: The custom domain to bind (verified via DNS TXT or CNAME).

txt_record.description: The DNS TXT record value retrieved by App from the customer's DNS.

schema.title: UpdateDomainRequest
